ask: can u add up whos coming w plus ones so i know how much turkey to get
sentence: Shows a shared headcount for an event where each person says if they are going and can add named plus ones up to a limit, with a running total of everyone coming.
use_when: Working out how much food to buy for a gathering based on who is coming
Collecting going or can't go answers along with guests each person is bringing
Host wants to open or close plus ones and see a live total
Counting attendees for a dinner, party or potluck in a group chat
dont_use_when: Picking a date, time or option by vote, which needs a poll
Splitting costs or tracking who owes money
Assigning dishes or items to bring, which needs a sign-up list
